title: WPO365 | LOGIN (wpo365-login) plugin before version 45.2 contains an authentication bypass by capture-replay…
description: The WPO365 | LOGIN (wpo365-login) plugin before version 45.2 has an authentication bypass vulnerability due to a capture-replay flaw. This occurs because the anti-replay check in the Saml2_Service::check_message_id() function does not persist processed SAML message IDs, allowing attackers to reuse a valid SAMLResponse multiple times within its validity window to log in as the victim, including administrators.
